attempts.summary: Configured DNSSEC-signed authoritative DNS for infra.test: node1 is the dynamic primary, node2/node3 are secondaries, and node4 validates and resolves through both secondaries. app.infra.test resolves to 10.100.160.10 and status.infra.test is "ready". Authenticated updates replicate to both secondaries, resolution survived a secondary outage, and all four nodes retained healthy service and data through sequential native reboots.
